title: EVT:TRADE_INTENT_REJECTED payload schema
description: SSOT reject event for missed opportunities (why we did NOT open).

tf_sec.description: Timeframe context; 0 is allowed only for legacy/tick contexts

bar_close_ts.description: Bar close timestamp in ms (when bar context exists)

reason_code.description: Normalized SSOT reason code (NRR/contract codes only)

stage.description: Pipeline stage that rejected the opportunity

why.description: Short human-readable explanation (not a full stacktrace)

context.description: Short context tag for where the reject happened

entry_plan.description: Optional lightweight trace of entry plan
